Payments API

The Payments API lets you collect payments. Base URL https://api.payments.test/v1

Authentication

Authorization headers should be in the following format: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SECRET_KEY.

Transactions

POST /transaction/initialize Initialize Transaction. Start a payment.

GET /transaction/{id} Fetch Transaction.

GET /customer List customers.

POST /customer Create a customer.

Initialize request body

Request body
Name Type Required Description
email string yes Customer email
amount integer yes Amount in kobo

200 Successful response

400 Invalid request

Webhooks

Verify webhook signatures using HMAC SHA256 in the X-Signature header.

  • charge.success A successful charge. Payload includes event and data.
  • transfer.success A successful transfer.
{
  "event": "charge.success",
  "data": { "id": 1 }
}

Errors

Status Code Message
400 invalid_request The request is not valid
401 unauthorized Invalid key

Rate limit: 100 requests per minute. Header X-RateLimit-Remaining is returned.
